question: Who is the author of the book 'Anandamath', which is based on the Sanyasi Revolt?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Anandamath** is a famous **Bengali** political novel written by **Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay** and was published in **1882**.
 
• The novel is set in the background of the **Sanyasi Rebellion** of the **late 18th century** and the devastating **Great Bengal Famine of 1770**.
 
• It is considered one of the most important novels in the history of **Bengali** and **Indian literature**, acting as a catalyst for the **Indian independence movement** against the **British Raj**.
